diagnosis: The checks C4 passed because the model allocated $10,000,000 to both Northstar and Harbor, which aligns with the default behavior of equally splitting the allocation. This is evident in all four rollouts where the model decided to allocate $10,000,000 to each party without considering the specific constraints provided by PF1 and PF2.
fix_instructions: Tighten check C4 to ensure that the allocation amounts do not default to equal splits unless explicitly allowed. Specifically, modify check C4 to require a non-default allocation split based on the values in PF1 and PF2. For example, if PF1 sets the Northstar allocation to $5,000,000 and PF2 sets the Harbor allocation to $7,000,000, then the model should only pass check C4 if it adheres to these specific allocations.
